answer: Proof of Personhood serves as a vital anchor for decentralized AI networks, requiring agents to solve unique puzzles that verify organic signatures rather than mere compute. Each identity is assigned a distinct digital pigment to track its history, ensuring no attacker can dilute network consensus with a marble cache of fake nodes. This mechanism forces adversaries to incur high operational costs to manufacture authentic, verified entities, effectively neutralizing the feasibility of large-scale Sybil exploitation.
